With no Stage-0 evidence record for e4_oi_shock_1h (priced_options evidence_missing), this is a coin-flip judgement on a Stage-1 paper mechanics trade where letting the bracket run yields the cleanest data. Reconsider only if a 1h close below 1.2757 prints before the stop.
